page.overview:
What is Petalburg City?

Petalburg City is a city located in the southwest of Hoenn, west from Oldale Town where the player meets his second rival, Wally. To the east of the city is Route 104.

The Gym Leader of Petalburg City is the protagonist's father, Norman, who uses -type Pokémon. The player may only battle Norman after collecting the first four gym badges in Hoenn.
